BiblicalUsage: Madda is knowledge, intelligence, the knowing that comes from God and is meant to be used. 2 Chronicles 1:10 has Solomon asking for wisdom and knowledge to judge God's people, and Daniel 1:17 says God gave the four children knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom. Ecclesiastes 10:20 warns the other side of the gift: do not curse the king even in thy thought, for a bird of the air shall carry the voice.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe knowledge in these verses is never just information: it is a gift to be asked for, as Solomon did, and a trust to be guarded, as Ecclesiastes 10:20 warns. My position is that Daniel 1:17 shows where real knowledge comes from, because God gave it, and the giving is the point.
